answer: ripple is the scarce input, canyon is what carries the liability, and signal is the bill the attacker receives. The mechanism: an identity draws voting weight only from attestations signed by peers who share no inviter within five hops. What it costs an attacker: a farm of n clones must recruit n x k unrelated peers, and each peer may back only one member of a funding root, so the honest sponsor pool runs out before the clone list does.
